decisions.reason: As a flagship organic salami line that remained on the website across both years and sits very close to the firm’s core curing and slicing know-how, it is highly likely to be retained.

Although its presentation appears less prominent in 2024 than at launch, it is still within the firm’s established salami competence and broad snack assortment, which makes continued learning and improvement feasible.
This organic boiled sausage directly builds on the firm’s existing meat-processing capabilities and organic expansion path, so management would likely keep it unless early sales clearly disappoint.
The thinly sliced organic chicken breast line fits the firm’s existing cold-cut expertise and stated growth in organic variants and new formats, giving it a strong case for continuation.

The organic herb-coated salami is close to the firm’s salami knowledge base and brand logic, though as a newer and seemingly narrower item it faces somewhat more pruning risk than the strongest lines.
